controllers: Two Arduino UNO R4 Minima boards with MAX3421E USB Host Shields
link: Direct Ethernet between two AX88279-based TimeSticks

lead_type_and_length: User confirmed the two measurement leads are the same type and approximately the same length; exact lengths and propagation delays were not measured.
ground: User confirmed the Saleae ground is connected to TimeStick signal ground.
digital_preset: 3.3+ V; vendor nominal switching threshold approximately 1.65 V
external_reference: None; grandmaster is free-running and not UTC-traceable
termination: Saleae digital inputs; no additional termination was documented
calibration: No traceable calibration or channel/cable skew correction
steady_window_rule: Exclude first 120 seconds of the 900-second capture; preserve and report the full record too.
